subject: Ciências
description_pt: Comparar características físicas entre os colegas, reconhecendo a diversidade e a importância da valorização, do acolhimento e do respeito às diferenças.

components.description_pt: Observar e descrever características físicas (cor do cabelo, cor dos olhos, altura, tom de pele) entre colegas
components.description_en: Observe and describe physical characteristics (hair color, eye color, height, skin tone) among classmates
components.cc_component_description: Observe and record physical traits of young plants or animals and their parents

components.description_pt: Reconhecer que a diversidade física entre pessoas é natural e esperada
components.description_en: Recognize that physical diversity among people is natural and expected
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between characteristics that are common to a species and those that vary among individuals

components.description_pt: Explicar a importância de respeitar e valorizar diferenças físicas entre indivíduos
components.description_en: Explain the importance of respecting and valuing physical differences among individuals

cc_matches.description: Make observations to construct an evidence-based account that young plants and animals are like, but not exactly like, their parents.
Individuals of the same kind of plant or animal are recognizable as similar but can also vary in many ways.
